title: Capability maturity model
root_cause: Capability labels conflate knowledge, contract, executable, behavioral, operational, and external-authority proof.
source_requirement: Derive L0-L6 maturity only from typed evidence and current dependency revisions.
implementation_steps: Map evidence types and authority classes to levels.
Cap maturity when dependencies are stale.
affected_tests: Semantic index, Skill Studio, operational ledger, and routing tests.
evidence_required: Level boundary vectors and stale-evidence downgrade receipt.
rollback: Remove derived maturity projection; preserve underlying evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Maturity is monotonic by evidence requirements and cannot exceed current proof.
